policy.boundarySummary: The v1.2 corpus explicitly covers raw object denial, path escape, permission bypass, lifecycle cleanup, packaged metadata mismatch, and Safe downgrade.

positiveCases: JSON-only live UI layout, event drain, update, close, and provider cleanup evidence remains imported from the Phase 13 live UI provider gate
P14-07 keeps packaged entry/update/close smoke evidence as provider POC evidence only
negativeCases: missing packaged ui capability rejects before provider dispatch
raw Activity, View, Window, Fragment, Handler, NativeView, Context, Binder, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: packaged metadata mismatch attempts to open UI without reviewed capability
background or scheduled execution tries to create a hidden Activity-owned UI
event callback payload attempts to carry executable JavaScript or raw Android object handles
runtimeGuards: UiHandle is opaque and ResourceRegistry-owned
bridge request payloads are JSON-only
provider destroy closes owned UI sessions and drains pending callbacks
promotionPreconditions: packaged task relaunch, crash recovery, disclosure, and Safe downgrade archives must pass before promotion
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include undeclared capability denial and stale metadata mismatch coverage
capabilities.rollback: Disable packaged live UI promotion and keep the Phase 13 provider POC/fail-closed behavior.

positiveCases: JSON-only overlay show, update, drainEvents, close, and closeAll provider POC evidence is recorded
overlay permission/OEM matrix records Android 12 and Android 15+ archive requirements
negativeCases: permission-denied overlay creation remains fail-closed
raw WindowManager, LayoutParams, FloatyWindow, WindowBridge, View, Context, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW packaged metadata mismatch
silent background overlay creation without foreground disclosure
permission revocation followed by stale overlay handle update
runtimeGuards: overlay sessions are ResourceRegistry-owned
closeAll and provider destroy remove owned overlay resources
scheduled/background silent overlays remain rejected
promotionPreconditions: foreground disclosure with stop action, packaged positive smoke, task-removal cleanup, relaunch/crash behavior, and leak stress must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include undeclared overlay capability and permission-denial cases
capabilities.rollback: Disable overlay promotion and keep ui.overlay as provider POC or stable denial until permission/disclosure/device evidence passes.

positiveCases: selector/action matrix imports JSON descriptor and compat alias evidence
packaged accessibility lifecycle fixture records explicit accessibility capability metadata and service declaration requirements
negativeCases: missing accessibility service or capability rejects before action dispatch
raw AccessibilityService, AccessibilityNodeInfo, UiObject, Context, Binder, selector handle, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: packaged metadata mismatch tries to enable accessibility silently
root or Shizuku fallback attempts to bypass unsupported gesture tiers
stale node snapshot is reused after service disconnect
runtimeGuards: selector results are frozen JSON snapshots
timeout and cancellation paths are bounded
service disconnect and provider destroy clear owned handles
promotionPreconditions: Android 12/15+ enabled-service archives, settings round-trip, disconnect, task-removal/relaunch, and unsupported-tier evidence must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include missing service, undeclared capability, and stale metadata denial
capabilities.rollback: Keep accessibility provider POC disabled for packaged promotion and fall back to explicit stable denial.

positiveCases: Activity-owned MediaProjection provider contract is documented
P13 screenshot/image/OCR state and optional real-device screen_capture smoke anchors are imported
negativeCases: media_projection remains fail-closed without prompt grant and foreground disclosure evidence
raw MediaProjection, ImageReader, Bitmap, VirtualDisplay, Intent, Activity, Context, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: background capture without user prompt
packaged metadata mismatch tries to synthesize screen capture authority
stale capture handle remains usable after stop or task removal
runtimeGuards: capture provider must be Activity-owned
capture resources must be ResourceRegistry-owned
stop, provider destroy, task removal, and crash recovery must close capture resources
promotionPreconditions: Android 12/15+ prompt grant/denial, one-frame capture, stop action, task-removal/relaunch/crash, and raw object absence archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must keep screen_capture metadata mismatch denied
capabilities.rollback: Keep media_projection disabled and preserve existing screenshot/image/OCR stable denial until Activity-owned evidence passes.

positiveCases: scoped readImage, recycle, fake-provider OCR, ML Kit OCR, invalid input, quota, and packaged fake-provider smoke evidence is imported
opaque image handle and OCR result shapes are documented in declaration and migration sync
negativeCases: live transform/match/color operations remain fail-closed until live provider evidence exists
raw Bitmap, Mat, ImageReader, Canvas, Paint, file descriptor, native pointer, Context, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: path escape through image read/save
unrecycled image handle leak
OCR provider-mode mismatch or model-absence bypass
runtimeGuards: image handles are opaque ids
quota and recycle paths are explicit
scoped filesystem validation applies to image inputs and outputs
promotionPreconditions: live image provider, packaged scoped output, quota/leak stress, capture/disclosure, provider-mode, and model-absence archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include image/OCR undeclared capability and stale handle denial
capabilities.rollback: Keep advanced image and OCR promotion disabled while preserving scoped fake-provider and stable denial behavior.

positiveCases: JSON-safe task database mutation descriptors and schema migration fixtures are documented
packaged work_manager fake-provider schedule/list/cancel smoke and scheduled_runner entry evidence are imported
negativeCases: require("tasks"), raw task database mutation, wall-clock daily/weekly scheduler parity, and packaged task row authority remain unpromoted
raw TimedTask, IntentTask, WorkManager, AlarmManager, JobScheduler, PendingIntent, database cursor, Intent, Context, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: path escape through scheduled script entry
packaged owner mismatch attempts to mutate another package row
corrupt or unknown future schema triggers unsafe reschedule
runtimeGuards: Node task ids are opaque and owner-scoped
Safe downgrade preserves legacy Rhino rows and ignores Node descriptors
corrupt descriptors quarantine without scheduler mutation
promotionPreconditions: live mutation tests, schema migration/rollback, packaged ownership/disclosure, task removal cleanup, process death, relaunch, and Safe downgrade archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include owner mismatch and undeclared task capability denial
capabilities.rollback: Disable task database promotion, ignore Node-owned descriptors on Safe downgrade, and preserve legacy Rhino task rows.

positiveCases: future tasks.broadcast descriptor, manifest patch, exported policy, trigger payload, and remove semantics are documented
packaged boundary smoke proves compat IntentTask helpers reject and future broadcast modules remain denied
negativeCases: static/dynamic receiver registration, manifest mutation, boot/package/custom wakeups, and raw trigger payload access remain unpromoted
raw BroadcastReceiver, Intent, IntentFilter, PendingIntent, Bundle, Uri, PackageManager, receiver handle, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: exported receiver metadata bypass without reviewed permission policy
oversized or privacy-sensitive broadcast payload
trigger after owner-scoped remove
runtimeGuards: future broadcast descriptors must be JSON-only and owner-scoped
custom receivers default to non-exported
payloads must be bounded and privacy-filtered
promotionPreconditions: positive install/trigger/remove, manifest synthesis, exported/permission policy, payload filtering, relaunch/crash, undeclared-capability, and cleanup archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include exported receiver denial and post-remove no-delivery evidence
capabilities.rollback: Keep broadcast task authority unpromoted and remove only owner-scoped future descriptors on rollback.

positiveCases: owned notify, cancel, cancelAll, permission status, and settings handoff evidence is recorded
provider destroy cancellation for owned active notifications is documented
negativeCases: packaged post/cancel and foreground disclosure remain unpromoted
raw Notification, NotificationChannel, NotificationManager, PendingIntent, RemoteViews, Intent, listener handle, StatusBarNotification, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: cancel unrelated app notification id
post notification without POST_NOTIFICATIONS state or packaged disclosure
advanced action/listener metadata mismatch
runtimeGuards: notification ids are owned by current Node execution
cancel and cancelAll are scoped to owned records
provider destroy cancels remaining owned active notifications
promotionPreconditions: packaged post/cancel, foreground disclosure/stop action, Android 12/15+ permission matrix, advanced notification decision, and rollback cleanup archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include undeclared notification capability and Safe downgrade behavior
capabilities.rollback: Disable notification promotion and cancel only provider-owned active notifications.

positiveCases: device.power battery optimization status and settings dry-run evidence is recorded
Android 12/15+, OEM, exact-alarm, background-launch, prompt, and rollback archive requirements are documented
negativeCases: request-ignore-battery-optimizations mutation, Doze mutation, wake locks, exact-alarm scheduling, and background-launch bypass remain denied
raw PowerManager, WakeLock, AlarmManager, PendingIntent, Intent, Context, OEM manager, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: permission bypass through settings intent mutation
background-launch bypass disguised as power prompt
exact-alarm metadata injection without reviewed prompt
runtimeGuards: device.power must be declared exactly
settings launch supports dryRun for tests
power state mutation stays stable-denied
promotionPreconditions: Android 12/15+ OEM matrix, exact-alarm state, background-launch restrictions, reviewed prompt, and rollback archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include power metadata mismatch denial
capabilities.rollback: Keep direct power mutation disabled and leave only read/dry-run status helpers.

positiveCases: recorder.getStatus and packaged recorder/media denial boundary smoke evidence is recorded
real recorder session contract documents runtime permission, foreground disclosure, ResourceRegistry session, temporary output, and cleanup requirements
negativeCases: recorder.start, recorder.stop, pause/resume, and packaged microphone recording remain unpromoted

raw MediaRecorder, AudioRecord, AudioPlaybackCaptureConfiguration, MediaProjection, ParcelFileDescriptor, file descriptor, Uri, Context, foreground service handle, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: microphone capture without runtime prompt or foreground disclosure
temporary output path escape
packaged relaunch or crash leaves active recording session
runtimeGuards: future recorder sessions must be ResourceRegistry-owned
temporary output must be scoped and cleaned on stop/destroy
foreground disclosure and stop action are required before recording promotion
promotionPreconditions: runtime microphone prompt, foreground disclosure, stop action, task removal, relaunch/crash, quota, temp cleanup, denied prompt, packaged start/stop stress, and Safe downgrade archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must include missing Android permission and undeclared media.recording capability denial
capabilities.rollback: Keep recorder start/stop disabled, close owned future sessions, and remove only scoped temporary output.

positiveCases: read-only audio status and scoped mediainfo remain documented
media playback and MediaStore boundary decision records stable-denied future-only state
negativeCases: playback, playlists, scanFile, MediaStore query/insert/update/delete/open-file, broad media permissions, and mutable media collection access remain denied

raw MediaPlayer, AudioTrack, AudioFocusRequest, ContentResolver, MediaStore cursor, MediaScannerConnection, Uri, ParcelFileDescriptor, file descriptor, playlist handle, Context, and Java object exposure remains denied
abuseCases: broad READ_MEDIA or MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission bypass
MediaStore path escape through open-file descriptor
playlist handle survives provider destroy
runtimeGuards: media future capabilities require new provider gate
broad media-library permissions stay stable-denied
raw media handles never cross into JavaScript
promotionPreconditions: scoped playback/provider decision, playlist/queue decision, MediaStore permission matrix, packaged denial, privacy, rollback, and raw object denial archives must pass
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must keep MediaStore metadata mismatch denied
capabilities.rollback: Keep media playback and MediaStore future-only with stable denial.

positiveCases: workerThreadsProfile and processWorkerReplacementProfile diagnostics are documented
P14-28 audits Node 24.5 ABI artifacts and records native worker unavailability
negativeCases: runnable worker, packaged worker, WorkerPool replacement API, process_worker, compute_worker, and autojs6:process-worker remain unpromoted
raw process handles, stdio streams, signals, spawn, fork, stable child_process authority, bridge modules, nested workers, and raw native handles remain denied
abuseCases: process-worker facade bypass through WorkerPool
worker bridge module import
packaged .mjs worker source graph without native preflight
raw child_process shell confusion
runtimeGuards: worker.preflight.status=available is required before runnable promotion
node:worker_threads remains shape-only while native workers are unavailable
child_process remains disabled and shell remains separate scoped bridge
promotionPreconditions: native, runnable, packaged, resource/RSS, execution slot, UX, security corpus, and rollback evidence must pass before worker/process promotion
P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must not count worker source anchors as packaged release evidence while native preflight is unavailable
capabilities.rollback: Keep autojs.nodejs.worker_threads.experimental=false, project/package worker opt-in disabled, no process-worker facade, and child_process denied.

positiveCases: Phase 14 promotion contracts define packaged high-privilege disclosure fields and raw object denials
packaged fixture gates record explicit metadata requirements for overlay, accessibility, tasks, broadcast, recorder/media, and image/OCR surfaces
negativeCases: undeclared capability, stale packaged descriptor, metadata mismatch, and Safe downgrade must reject before provider dispatch
packaged metadata cannot synthesize unreviewed Android permissions, profile switches, expanded filesystem roots, or high-privilege providers
abuseCases: package declares Android permission without node permission
package declares future capability before provider promotion
Safe downgrade leaves persistent task, receiver, overlay, notification, recorder, or worker authority active
runtimeGuards: packaged high-privilege disclosure contract requires manifestMetadata, installReviewCopy, runReviewCopy, foreground disclosure, stop action, denied diagnostics, cleanup, privacy, and rollback fields
profile switches default to Safe and remain default-off
packaged aggregate smoke must prove undeclared capability denial and Safe downgrade cleanup
promotionPreconditions: P14-34 packaged aggregate smoke must produce deterministic build/reports/nodejs artifacts
P14-37 summary gate must report zero release-blocking security corpus violations before closeout
capabilities.rollback: Disable promoted capability switches, keep Safe profile default, and remove only package-owned high-privilege state on downgrade.
